content.text: Micron Technology, Inc. Form 10-Q for the quarter ended February 26, 2026: Micron’s filing describes two planned Idaho fabs: first-fab DRAM wafer output projected for mid-calendar 2027, and second-fab construction planned for 2026 with operation expected by end-2028. The cited passage does not assign a $35 billion cost to an Idaho facility; it establishes project scope and expected timing, not completed output. (time=2026-03-19; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
